description: This file defines a Flutter widget for the library screen of an e-book reader app. It displays a list of books stored locally, using provider for state management.

classes.name: LibraryScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays the user's library of saved books.

classes.name: _LibraryScreenState
classes.description: State class for LibraryScreen managing initialization and building the UI.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state, loads the library data from the database.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the library screen, showing a message if the library is empty or a list of books.
